about_the_game:
Escape Dungeon II - Shunral the Silver Wolf Artbook

This time, the “Silver Wolf - Shunral” sheds her battle gear and reveals every moment, every massive scene from her defeats.

This official artbook collects all the original high-resolution artwork from Escape Dungeon II - Shunral the Silver Wolf. Whether you're a devoted fan or just want to relive the iconic moments, this is a must-have collector’s item.

Artbook Features

  • Torn & nude Shunral portraits – Complete illustrations showing Shunral’s fully exposed and battle-damaged forms.

  • All erotic scenes included – Every adult scene is presented with multiple variant CGs capturing each key moment.

  • Ultra high resolution (6000px) – Zoom in on every detail with crystal clarity and uncompromised quality.

  • Full monster gallery – Features all monsters from the game in complete detail for the first time.

  • Officially licensed content – Faithfully preserves the game’s art style and atmosphere.

Zoom in on Shunral’s finest parts

From sneaking deep into the Dark Continent, infiltrating the Demon Capital, to her final assassination attempt on the Demon Lord Karren—
this artbook takes you back into the world of Escape Dungeon II to relive every breathtaking defeat scene in massive scale.

content_descriptors.notes:
・All characters portrayed in this game are over the age of 20. 
・This game contains a lot of sexual content as well as non-consensual sex.
・This game depicts both physical and mental/emotional violence.
